purpose: 让已审的自足单字取意进入自动选字，同时不把单字准入升级为整名结论。

permits: 原条/读音/词性/义项和字形证据展示
原创单字选义与意象说明
通用/条件性进入新版本选字和逐字解释
有证据时的特定组合说明
真实家庭偏好和纪念事实
doesNotPermit: 倒置成所有单字的逐家庭签字前提
空白全名审核阻塞已批准中性逐字选材

evidenceGates.required: loader authenticates expected file/manifest/source locks plus dictionary entry, reading, POS and sense; no caller boolean or re-hashed self-signed substitute
exact char, source word, default selected reading/tone, baseline record, readings, definition and fixed glyph relation; 叶 stays pending
one reusable project review with caseId, reviewId, exact new project text/limits, authority separated from dictionary

Execute only explicit machineConditions: exact reading/tone/sense, namePart, allowed length, explicit theme IDs, and pending source identity. conditionIds label these fields; conflictIds are classified in conflict-registry.json, not an unspecified semantic predicate.
only pinned character-level intent and limits; wholeNameMeaning=null absent separately admitted whole-name rule; no template turns objects into personality
one assess gate for pool/required/local/AI and saved receipt validation; source/identity failure cannot fall back
new publication/source/version IDs; old bytes and history frozen; coverage based on actual loaded eligible sets and real consumers, not row count

minimalSufficientRule: E1 & E2 & E3 & decision=allow-single-character-generation & E4. This is sufficient for per-character automatic eligibility without family signature or per-future-name manual approval. E5/E6/E7 govern actual delivery and activation.

contextRules.themeIds: explicit known enum list, no free-text inference or gender/surname/industry guess
contextRules.givenNameLengths: validate candidate occurrence; pool must receive requested given-name length
contextRules.namePart: given-name only; surname does not consume these rows
contextRules.truePersonalDedication: requires actual provided event only when making a dedication claim
contextRules.falseContext: must fail identical to absent condition

consumerRules: M751 may implement opt-in 7.2 module/facade; CURRENT/service/store registration is a separate integration task.

At pool stage preserve legacyEligiblePool union newlyAdmittedEligibleSet; never label all old generator characters admitted by 521. Required chars cannot bypass new row pending/theme/reading/source gates.

If legacy evaluator returns a candidate, v72 finalizer must verify every claimed adopted row and replace only its unreviewed-character warning with exact scoped explanation/limits. Other warnings remain.

Old whole-name output, currentCharacterWarning manual wording, reason/themes and score credit cannot smuggle a new row into a confirmed whole-name statement. Explicitly scoped changed fields must be versioned and replayable.

Preserve existing score algorithm; new admission metadata cannot set semanticTags/elements/citations or add +score. Keep old numeric evaluation if facade reuses the old evaluator; different candidate population may naturally change relative results.
AI may suggest character strings, but receives no source/admission authority. Final eligibility and explanation rendered from trusted records; reject unverified whole-name assertions.

Save receipt binds version, base pack, publication, exact candidate/full-name and per-occurrence reading/sense/project hashes and theme context. Recompute on read/restore; absent optional fields in legacy sessions remain absent.
No exhaustion fallback to pending/unadmitted rows to reach twelve names. Return actual fewer names or a scoped explanation.
Existing avoidance, parent-name, phonetic and required-character constraints still apply; not claiming exhaustive naturalness or oral-error detection.

knownSenseConflictPolicy.nonPredicateConflictLabels: Do not block all names merely because a warning label exists. Keep pinned limitations and no alternate whole-name claim.
knownSenseConflictPolicy.wholeNameClaims: Separate approved rule required only when actually making a whole-name claim; no claim => no per-future-name signature requirement.
knownSenseConflictPolicy.scope: Existing product hard constraints continue outside the new addition; this contract adds no unseen matcher/score.

historicalPolicy.manualScopeRevision: M752 newly grants reusable characterwise policy; M744 did not grant generation and its manual requirements are not silently rewritten
historicalPolicy.leafIdentity: 叶 pending until separate identity audit

coverage.semantics: 521 counts default automatically usable meanings, not an exclusive generator whitelist or full-name approvals
mustReport: eligibleForRequest unique characters by actual context

verificationScope: decision contract and pinned-source correspondence only; product generator, UI, persistence and installer acceptance belong to M751/root and are not run by M752
supersedes: r1 machine fixture dispatch only; original artifacts remain immutable

output-assertion.purpose: inspect candidate output; a rejected output is not a new eligibility status

legacy-replay.purpose: legacy7.1 remains byte-equivalent and has no new receipt; do not route to v72 assess

validationOrder: plain context schema incl. valid theme enum and exact known caseId
trusted source/identity checks; if a receipt is supplied or required by receipt-validation, validate it

assessScopes.qualification: Run the same eligibility policy at all six caller stages, before attempting receipt issue. Pending and no-theme cases need no successful receipt. These tests do not perform actual persistence.
assessScopes.receipt-validation: Actual eligible producer receipt is required. Tampered context/reading/sense/name/position is rejected-integrity, never needs-theme. Actual save/restore success requires this check in addition to qualification.

fixturePolicy.baselineResolution: recordRef resolves exact pinned M752 row; entryRef resolves M740 baselineCharacter by candidateCaseId; resource handle is actual fixed loader result, not a constructed object
fixturePolicy.patchMerge: shallow top-level context field replacement; arrays fully replaced; null is literal and not deletion; absent preserves baseline; no implicit deletion or source mutation; fixtures explicitly update givenName/fullName when length/surname changes
fixturePolicy.faultInjection: harness-only alteration of source reads or receipt after obtaining actual trusted baseline; never expose as app API
fixturePolicy.trustedHandle: M751 fixed loader must create actual verified handle; string labels confer no authority
fixturePolicy.saveRestore: qualification-only stage templates are NOT storage success; actual save/restore needs eligible producer receipt and receipt-validation; missing legacy runtime receipt means not-executed
